diagram_previews.alt: Right triangle ABC with the right angle at C at the bottom left, A above C and B to the right. D is the midpoint of AB, E on AC and F on CB with a right-angle mark at D between DE and DF; EF is drawn. The reflection E' of E in D lies to the right of AB; blue dashed segments join E' to D, B and F, with a right-angle mark at B between BE' and BC.
